status: Three full-text treatments were inspected for the A page and two independent full-text treatments for the B examples. Rawnsley supplies the detailed coupled proof and R/6 coefficient; Wells supplies an independent book treatment; Donaldson’s R/8 display is excluded under the adopted R=12 convention. The batch-67 analytic comparison carrier and proof are present and interface-matched, but its current Step 1 readiness record is missing.
